title: YOLOX Exceeding YOLO Series in 2021
contribution: Anchor-free detector with decoupled head and SimOTA.
limitation: General object detection does not establish queue estimation accuracy at a fixed roadside camera.
use: Keep as an older reproducible detector baseline; benchmark locally.

title: ByteTrack Multi Object Tracking by Associating Every Detection Box
contribution: Associates lower-confidence detections with existing tracks.
limitation: Reported MOT benchmarks cannot establish vehicle counting accuracy for this intersection.
use: Preferred initial tracker; measure duplicate crossings and missed vehicles.

authors: Aharon N Orfaig R Bobrovsky B
title: BoT SORT Robust Associations Multi Pedestrian Tracking
contribution: Combines motion and appearance with camera-motion compensation.
limitation: Pedestrian evaluation and added appearance processing require validation on stationary-camera traffic.
use: Alternative if identity continuity fails with ByteTrack.

title: DETRs Beat YOLOs on Real time Object Detection
contribution: RT-DETR provides an end-to-end transformer detection design.
limitation: Published throughput uses particular hardware and workloads.
use: Detector alternative; measure end-to-end latency on the project machine.

authors: Wang C Y Bochkovskiy A Liao H Y M
title: YOLOv7 Trainable bag of freebies sets new state of the art for real time object detectors
contribution: Training and architecture improvements target real-time detection.
limitation: Generic detection results do not resolve night-time occlusion and camera perspective.
use: Compare a practical YOLO-family model with RT-DETR rather than assuming a family winner.

title: Observation Centric SORT Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi Object Tracking
contribution: Uses observations to reduce accumulated motion errors through occlusion.
limitation: Tracking speed without detector cost is not complete pipeline speed.
use: Third tracking alternative for occlusion stress tests.

title: StrongSORT Make DeepSORT Great Again
type: IEEE Transactions on Multimedia accepted 2023 arXiv version
contribution: Improves a tracking baseline and studies association and interpolation.
limitation: Global linking and interpolation variants need an online-causality check before use in a controller.
use: Use online-only alternatives in live feedback; reserve retrospective repair for analysis.

authors: Wang C Y Yeh I H Liao H Y M
title: YOLOv9 Learning What You Want to Learn Using Programmable Gradient Information
contribution: Introduces programmable gradient information and GELAN.
limitation: Architecture improvements do not remove the need for site-specific annotation.
use: Candidate when detector errors dominate the queue estimate.

title: Traffic Co Simulation Framework Empowered by Infrastructure Camera Sensing and Reinforcement Learning
type: Journal of Intelligent Transportation Systems arXiv v2
contribution: Connects camera-based sensing with CARLA and SUMO and investigates imperfect sensing.
limitation: A co-simulation result is not evidence of performance at the selected real site.
use: Direct motivation for ideal-sensing versus noisy-sensing ablation.

title: PressLight Learning Max Pressure Control to Coordinate Traffic Signals in Arterial Network
contribution: Uses pressure-based state and reward design in reinforcement learning.
limitation: Network experiments and learned policy design differ from a two-phase local heuristic.
use: Foundational rationale; do not label longest-queue control as max-pressure without downstream queues.

title: CoLight Learning Network level Cooperation for Traffic Signal Control
contribution: Uses graph attention to exchange information between intersections.
limitation: Coordination adds topology and communication requirements outside a one-junction scope.
use: Foundational justification for deferring network-wide coordination.

title: SocialLight Distributed Cooperation Learning towards Network Wide Traffic Signal Control
contribution: Uses distributed cooperative learning and evaluates in SUMO and CityFlow.
limitation: A network-learning approach brings training and attribution costs beyond the minimum prototype.
use: Future extension; retain explicit baselines before adopting MARL.

title: TraCI and traffic light control documentation
contribution: Provides external simulation control through TraCI.
limitation: Simulation configuration and version must be frozen for reproducibility.
use: Selected evaluation adapter and controlled signal transition mechanism.

title: CityFlow project documentation
contribution: Traffic simulator aimed at city-scale multi-agent research with a Python interface.
limitation: This project needs only one junction; a city-scale simulator is not essential.
use: Open research comparator and simulation alternative.

title: PTV Vissim product documentation
limitation: Product descriptions are vendor evidence, not independent accuracy or price comparisons.
use: Existing-system comparator; access and API edition require checking.

title: Aimsun Next transport modelling software
contribution: Supports microscopic and broader-scale traffic modelling.
limitation: Edition-specific integration rights and availability require confirmation.
use: Existing-system comparator; no assumed student licence.

title: FastAPI documentation
contribution: Typed Python API framework with automatic API documentation.
limitation: An API framework does not schedule inference workers by itself.
use: Future API boundary; run inference in a separate worker.

title: Appropriate Uses For SQLite
contribution: Embedded database suitable for many local application uses.
limitation: High writer concurrency and remote multi-user operation need separate assessment.
use: Initial local run metadata store; move to PostgreSQL if concurrency requires it.
